text.EN: Damn {killer}. {subject} was my friend, and this will cost you.
text.TL: Bwisit ka, {killer}. Kaibigan ko si {subject}; pagbabayaran mo ito.

text.EN: I saw {subject} fall. {killer} will answer for it.
text.TL: Nakita kong bumagsak si {subject}. Mananagot si {killer}.

text.EN: Hell, {subject}. What {killer} did will not be forgotten.
text.TL: Lintik, {subject}. Hindi malilimutan ang ginawa ni {killer}.

text.EN: I will not let {subject} be forgotten, and {killer} will not get away with it.
text.TL: Hindi ko hahayaang makalimutan si {subject}, at hindi makakatakas si {killer}.

text.EN: {subject} always had my back. Today, I am coming for {killer}.
text.TL: Lagi akong ipinagtatanggol ni {subject}. Ngayon, ako naman ang hahabol kay {killer}.
Putang ina, {killer}. Mahalaga sa amin si {subject}.

text.EN: I hope {killer} knows what they took from us when they killed {subject}.
text.TL: Sana alam ni {killer} ang inagaw niya sa amin nang pinatay niya si {subject}.

text.EN: No more warnings. {killer} killed one of ours, {subject}.
text.TL: Wala nang babala. Pinatay ni {killer} ang isa sa amin, si {subject}.
